projectState.summary: Byte 10f-b2 is implemented locally on a fresh branch from main. The projected JSON model-facing response schema no longer includes pitch; the prompt/primer tell models to emit scaleDegree plus octave, and `src/ollama.ts` derives canonical pitch before validation without masking out-of-range degrees. The Vite Ollama proxy now propagates browser aborts to upstream fetches. Build is green and smoke is 12/12, including derived-pitch and proxy-failure mock-fallback coverage. No model output is scheduled into music.
